verdict.rationale: Floot documents an official remote MCP server that lets external clients/agents (Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude, ChatGPT) connect and drive the builder — exposing tools like get_logs, query_database, create_checkpoint, generate_image — running on the user's own Claude/ChatGPT subscription rather than Floot credits, directly matching the ask of bringing your own coding agent to drive the project. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a third-party agent can fully replace the built-in one, and details on any limitations when using external agents versus native.
